mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate relative to its historical average compresses the discount rate applied to equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance becomes more accommodative.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede economic slowdowns and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A positive interaction between strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS growth) and robust industrial production (INDPRO growth) indicates a self-reinforcing economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits accelerate.
failure_condition: In periods where PAYEMS > 130000 and INDPRO > 90, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations and signal economic contraction.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes increased consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is above 500, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90 signals weakening supply chain activity and economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate output and profits.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 90, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.5%) and weak consumer spending (RSAFS < 370000) indicates a severe economic slowdown, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in recessionary risks.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 9.5% and RSAFS < 370000, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a housing boom (HOUST > 550), the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 5 trading days as investors rotate out of equities into the real estate sector, leading to negative forward returns due to sector-specific valuation pressures.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 550, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
